requirement: TripAdvisor Research uses SerpApi first, ordered fallbacks and attributed review photos

oracle.invariant: Every selected Node test passes with zero failures, cancellations or skipped tests. Unique branch identity requires corroboration; same restaurant name and city may supply attributed reviews across branches without a website or identity merge. A new source enriches a fresh snapshot once; successful old data survives provider errors. Budget refusal pauses before network, resume uses the search checkpoint once and cancelled leases do not publish. Settings keeps keys private and uses only key status for Test. TripAdvisor reviews reach brief and handoff rendering, require source/author attribution and remain outside business fact evidence. Website-only prefetch never starts paid enrichment and campaign control errors propagate. OneAPI primary success never spends Litescrape quota; a same-brand association can succeed without exact branch evidence, while provider failures use isolated fallback attempts. HTTP 200 application failures are not empty matches; budget, lease and cancellation never trigger fallback. Pinned identity and unknown-attempt checkpoints survive fallback and refresh without mixing branches or double charging. Customer Research reaches Details and an attributed brief; unavailable optional reviews add no empty section or provider quota error. SerpApi primary success uses exactly search/place/reviews with no fallback; its HTTP200 errors and exact place ID echoes are validated. Gallery and review-attached photos use standard media storage and survive profile, customer Details, revision manifest and demo build with source credit. Author profile/avatar and same-review photo associations survive provider-switch refresh; reviewer avatars never become venue media. An ordinary Research retries an earlier not-found result after the matching policy upgrade without refreshing current Google data. SerpApi returns up to twenty TripAdvisor reviews in one request and retains the twentieth through shared profile and brief. Refresh reuses a previously accepted TripAdvisor ID without search, revalidates the listing and preserves old data on identity mismatch. User Research collects up to twenty Google Maps menu photos with cached identifiers, preserving official Google facts and source credit through profile, brief and demo manifest. Menu discovery uses at most three provider calls initially, one for a cached refresh and zero for a fresh snapshot; optional quota errors stay hidden and budget resume reuses successful steps.
